title: Drivers autocompact at 400k, a 500k safety stop, both configurable
summary: Drivers compact themselves (about 400k by default, host dependent) instead of handing back early; a 500k maximum ends a Driver whose autocompact fails. Both configurable. Owner, 2026-11-27: stays in backlog P1. Spec to rewrite; open points in 02-answers.md.
